deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application deadline
deadlines.note: All required materials, including recommendation letters, must be received by the deadline.

english.note: International applicants must submit official TOEFL/IELTS scores unless exempt under USC policy. Central score thresholds exempt admitted students from the ISE exam; they are not stated as admission minimums.

applicationFee.note: USC offers waiver categories requiring approval before submission. Financial-hardship waivers are domestic-only; international applicants should confirm eligibility for other categories with the program.

documents: Examples of research works, if available

funding.note: All admitted students receive support during graduate training, including full tuition remission, a living stipend, health insurance and student health center fees.

sources.label: NGP requirements, funding and mentor selection
